pipeline_flow.name: USER_OR_GOAL_INTAKE
pipeline_flow.description: Incoming user directive or autonomous economic goal ingestion
pipeline_flow.guard: CrossDeviceIntakeEngine (rejects unverified worker claims, enforces HUMAN_GATE)

pipeline_flow.name: OPPORTUNITY_AND_TASK_PLANNER
pipeline_flow.description: Selects highest-ranked opportunity and defines minimal €0 test envelope

pipeline_flow.name: TASK_NEGOTIATION_AND_RESOURCE_LOCK
pipeline_flow.description: Hierarchical NTFS case-safe mutex acquisition for target paths and task signature

pipeline_flow.name: PROCESS_LEASE_ACQUISITION
pipeline_flow.description: Issues process lease with composite identity tuple (PID, START_TIME, TASK_TOKEN)

pipeline_flow.name: TASK_PASSPORT_STAMPING
pipeline_flow.description: Generates HMAC-signed capability passport binding task_id, version, and scope_paths

pipeline_flow.name: BORDER_GUARD_PRE_DISPATCH
pipeline_flow.description: Authoritative pre-dispatch gate verifying lease, resource lock, and passport signature

pipeline_flow.name: WORKER_EXECUTION
pipeline_flow.description: Executes sandboxed task and emits output artifacts and exit code
pipeline_flow.invariants: Zero spend (€0), Zero real trades, Local workspace only

pipeline_flow.name: RESULT_ENVELOPE_SUBMISSION
pipeline_flow.description: Contains passport, task_id, exit_code, and artifact manifest

pipeline_flow.name: RESULT_CUSTOMS_AND_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION
pipeline_flow.description: Verifies HMAC signature, exit code 0, non-empty artifacts, and disk SHA-256 hashes

pipeline_flow.name: COMPLETION_GOVERNOR_ADMISSION
pipeline_flow.description: Revokes worker global DONE claims; admits completion only with verified evidence

pipeline_flow.name: TERMINAL_EVIDENCE_AND_NEXT_TASK
pipeline_flow.description: Appends SHA-256 fingerprinted audit event to durable ledger and advances state
